title: 3810. Minimum Operations to Reach Target Array

examples.explanation: Choose x = 1: maximal segment [0, 0] updated -> nums becomes [2, 2, 3] Choose x = 2: maximal segment [0, 1] updated (nums[0] stays 2, nums[1] becomes 1) -> nums becomes [2, 1, 3] Thus, 2 operations are required to convert nums to target.
Choose x = 4: maximal segments [0, 0] and [2, 2] updated (nums[2] stays 4) -> nums becomes [5, 1, 4] Thus, 1 operation is required to convert nums to target.

Choose x = 7: maximal segments [0, 0] and [2, 2] updated -> nums becomes [5, 3, 9] Choose x = 3: maximal segment [1, 1] updated -> nums becomes [5, 5, 9] Thus, 2 operations are required to convert nums to target.
